date.as_written: nepālavatsaragate śiśusvādasiṃdhau, pauṣe ʼsite śiśiramāsi tithau navamyāṃ || svātīṣu śūlavanayogabudhe ca vāre, taulisthacandramakarastha divākare ca

notes: The chronogram 'śiśu-svāda-siṃdhu' represents a year in the 760s NS (svāda = 6, sindhu = 7, śiśu = ?), during the reign of King Jagatprakāśamalla of Bhaktapur (r. NS 764–792 / 1644–1672 CE). The scribe's name Kutu is marked with an exclamation mark in the cataloguer's transcription, indicating an unusual or corrupt reading.
